rlottie for VaCuus Lottie rendering
===================================
upstream: https://github.com/Samsung/rlottie
commit: ea06d2f29ba01b8d06c00a838d107f5e484ae59b
commit date: 2026-10-01
vendored: 2026-10-20

Pinned upstream master includes fixes after the last formal v0.2 release (2020).
Copied inc/, src/vector/, src/lottie/, licenses/, COPYING and CMakeLists.txt.
The CMake file records the upstream source list; UBT compiles the relays instead.
C/wasm bindings and examples are not built. config.h intentionally enables none of
LOTTIE_THREAD, LOTTIE_MODULE or LOTTIE_CACHE: rendering stays on the owning UI thread,
image decoding is linked directly, and a replaced JSON file cannot hit a global model
cache keyed only by filename.

Local patches:
- inc/rlottie.h, inc/rlottiecommon.h and src/vector/stb/stb_image.cpp recognize
  RLOTTIE_BUILD_STATIC so Win64 does not import/export private static-embed symbols.
- vdrawhelper.cpp, vdrawhelper_common.cpp and vdrawhelper_neon.cpp gate NEON on
  RLOTTIE_NO_NEON_ASM. UE arm64 uses scalar routines; upstream's optimized path
  requires 32-bit ARM assembler that is not part of this build. SSE2 is unchanged.
- lottieparser.cpp loads external images through VaCuusVectorResources::LoadChildFile,
  preserving directory-relative confinement without requiring host realpath for a
  bundle entry. Embedded data images use the upstream decoder.

Keep every in-file notice and licenses/ with the source. The imported vector,
FreeType, stb, RapidJSON and zip sources retain their respective licenses.

The upstream COPYING summary omits src/vector/vinterpolator.cpp, whose header
licenses that unmodified file under MPL 2.0. licenses/COPYING.MPL is retained,
and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md lists it separately.
